tools.name: iban_check
tools.description: Validate an IBAN by ISO 13616 structure and MOD-97-10 checksum (offline, no bank lookup).

tools.name: lei_check
tools.description: Validate a Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442 + ISO 7064 MOD-97-10 check digits).

tools.name: vat_mod97_check
tools.description: Structural VAT check (BE mod-97 family).

tools.name: company_number_format
tools.description: Validate UK Companies House number format (not existence).

tools.name: rent_deposit_guard
tools.description: Rental deposit safety: IBAN checksum + property/deposit country alignment + pre-viewing flag.

tools.name: rental_listing_risk
tools.description: Explainable rental-fraud risk score over listing red-flag signals (deterministic rule engine).

tools.name: rental_verdict
tools.description: One combined, signed rental due-diligence verdict: deposit + landlord entity (LEI/company) + listing risk.

tools.name: batch_validate
tools.description: Run up to 50 identifier checks (IBAN / LEI / VAT / UK company / SWIFT / ABA / EIN / IFSC / ABN / Luhn / ISBN / E.164 / SEDOL / ISIN / EAN-13 / GSTIN / context-distill) in ONE paid call: one voucher, one settlement, one signed XDR-1 receipt covering the whole batch. Flat price regardless of count — a

tools.name: swift_bic_check
tools.description: Validate a SWIFT/BIC code by ISO 9362 structure (bank code, ISO country, location, optional branch).

tools.name: aba_routing_check
tools.description: Validate a US ABA routing number by its (3,7,1)-weight mod-10 checksum.

tools.name: ein_format_check
tools.description: Validate US Employer Identification Number FORMAT (NN-NNNNNNN). No public EIN checksum exists.

tools.name: ifsc_check
tools.description: Validate an Indian IFSC by RBI structure (BBBB0NNNNNN; 5th character always 0).

tools.name: abn_check
tools.description: Validate an Australian Business Number by its mod-89 checksum (11 digits).

tools.name: luhn_check
tools.description: Validate any 12-19 digit number by the Luhn mod-10 algorithm (card-style checksums). Never submit real card numbers.

tools.name: isbn_check
tools.description: Validate an ISBN-10 (mod-11) or ISBN-13 (1,3-weight mod-10) checksum.

tools.name: e164_check
tools.description: Validate a phone number's E.164 structure (+CC, 8-15 digits, no leading zero).

tools.name: sedol_check
tools.description: Validate a UK/Ireland security identifier by its (1,3,1,7,3,9)-weight mod-10 checksum.

tools.name: vendor_onboarding_pack
tools.description: Screen a vendor's identifiers in ONE signed call: IBAN + LEI + VAT + UK company number — each checksummed, one verdict, one receipt. Half the price of four single checks.

tools.name: settlement_history_check
tools.description: On-chain counterparty check: USDC transfers SENT and RECEIVED by an address over the last ~48h of Base blocks (counts, volumes, sample tx hashes). Preflighted so you never pay during an RPC outage.

tools.name: balance_check
tools.description: On-chain balance snapshot: native ETH balance plus one ERC-20 token balance (defaults to USDC on Base), with raw units and decimals provenance. Preflighted so you never pay during an RPC outage.

tools.name: erc20_balance
tools.description: Raw + formatted ERC-20 balanceOf for an address at any token contract (decimals read on-chain when available; common-list/18 fallback is labeled). Preflighted so you never pay during an RPC outage.

tools.name: tx_activity
tools.description: On-chain activity snapshot for an address: total outbound transaction count (nonce), whether the address is a contract (eth_getCode), and a first-funded heuristic (nonce > 0). Preflighted so you never pay during an RPC outage.

tools.name: block_info
tools.description: Latest (or specified) Base block header: number, timestamp, transaction count, base fee. Preflighted so you never pay during an RPC outage.

tools.name: isin_check
tools.description: Validate an ISIN (ISO 6166) by structure and Luhn mod-10 check digit over the A=10…Z=35 converted string.

tools.name: ean13_check
tools.description: Validate an EAN-13 barcode by its mod-10 checksum (odd positions x1, even positions x3).

tools.name: gstin_check
tools.description: Validate an Indian GSTIN by structure (2-digit state code + PAN + entity code + 'Z') and its mod-36 cross-sum checksum.

tools.name: crypto_ticker
tools.description: Current spot price (USD) for a symbol via the public CoinGecko API; common tickers (btc, eth, …) are mapped to CoinGecko ids automatically. Cached 60s server-side; preflighted so you never pay during an API outage.

tools.name: context_distill
tools.description: Deterministic text digest: word count, top-5 most frequent meaningful words (stop words excluded), first sentence, and a keccak-256 content hash. Pure function — no external calls, no ML.

tools.name: cnpj_check
tools.description: Validate Brazilian CNPJ (14 digits) with dual Mod-11 check digits.

tools.name: uscc_check
tools.description: Validate Chinese Unified Social Credit Code (GB 32100-2015 ISO 7064 Mod-31-3).

tools.name: japan_corp_check
tools.description: Validate Japanese Houjin Bangou (13 digits, National Tax Agency Mod-9 check digit).

tools.name: kra_pin_check
tools.description: Validate Kenyan Revenue Authority Tax PIN structure (A/P + 9 digits + 1 letter).

tools.name: rfc_check
tools.description: Validate Mexican SAT RFC for companies (12 chars) or individuals (13 chars).

tools.name: iso20022_validate
tools.description: Validate an ISO 20022 banking XML document (pain.001 or pacs.008) with XXE guards and IBAN checksums.

tools.name: iso20022_to_x402_intent
tools.description: Autonomous banking migration: translate legacy ISO 20022 pain.001/pacs.008 XML directly into zero-float EIP-3009 Base L2 USDC payment intent.
